import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int mod = 998244353;
    static int g = 3;

    static long qpow(long a, long n) {
        long x = 1;
        a %= mod;
        while (n > 0) {
            if ((n & 1) == 1) x = x * a % mod;
            a = a * a % mod;
            n >>= 1;
        }
        return x;
    }

    static void rader(long[] y, int len) {
        for (int i = 1, j = len / 2; i < len - 1; i++) {
            if (i < j) {
                long tmp = y[i];
                y[i] = y[j];
                y[j] = tmp;
            }
            int k = len / 2;
            while (j >= k) {
                j -= k;
                k /= 2;
            }
            if (j < k) j += k;
        }
    }

    static void NTT(long[] y, int len, int on) {
        rader(y, len);
        for (int h = 2; h <= len; h <<= 1) {
            long wn = qpow(g, (mod - 1) / h);
            if (on == -1) wn = qpow(wn, mod - 2);
            for (int j = 0; j < len; j += h) {
                long w = 1;
                for (int k = j; k < j + h / 2; k++) {
                    long u = y[k];
                    long t = w * y[k + h / 2] % mod;
                    y[k] = (u + t) % mod;
                    y[k + h / 2] = (u - t + mod) % mod;
                    w = w * wn % mod;
                }
            }
        }
        if (on == -1) {
            long t = qpow(len, mod - 2);
            for (int i = 0; i < len; i++)
                y[i] = y[i] * t % mod;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt(), m = sc.nextInt();
        int len = 1, nn = n / 2;
        while (len < (9 * nn + 1)) len <<= 1;
        long[] a = new long[len];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            a[x] = 1;
